name: dca-marketplace
description: Claude Code plugins for Domain-Centric Architecture (DCA) and general software craftsmanship — composable skills and reviewer agents for daily practice.

plugins.name: dca-core
plugins.description: DCA-specific skills and agents for Java/Spring and .NET/C#: bootstrap that adds the published dca-building-blocks/dca-archunit or DomainCentric.BuildingBlocks/ArchRules packages and generates one architecture test, framework-free domain discipline, ubiquitous language glossaries, strategic context maps, scaffolding, semantic review, the tactical-modelling craft and the domain and boundaries review perspectives as skills, plus thin builder and reviewer agents around them. Pairs well with software-craftsmanship.

plugins.name: software-craftsmanship
plugins.description: Project-agnostic craftsmanship skills and agents: Test-Driven Development workflow, Clean Code principles while writing, Architecture Decision Records (Michael Nygard format), the craft of end-user browser tests (Page Objects, stable selectors), plus Clean-Code reviewer and E2E builder agents. Usable on any Java or .NET project without DCA assumptions. Pairs well with dca-core for full DCA practice.

plugins.name: dca-factory
plugins.description: Delivery pipeline for DCA projects, in three parts: a project description under project/ (product, technical decisions, designed domain — written through the method's description skill), a markdown backlog contract (epics with intent, goal, outcome-event metric and domain contact; stories with keyed acceptance criteria), and a runner — the stage skills plan/test/build/tidy/judge/document with one hand-over file each and a dependency-free story gate between them that checks epic completeness, one red-then-green end-user test per criterion, the architecture suite and the documentation claims. factory-setup sets it up idempotently (stack detection from presets, carrier lines only for installed skills), factory-backlog writes the backlog, factory-decisions answers what a run may not decide itself, factory-status and factory-verify look at it. Portable by construction: plain skill folders and one dependency-free script, with no harness-specific tool in the contract. Carries no architecture method and no project knowledge — those stay in dca-core and in the project's stack profile.
